name: newtoncloud.task.fetch
displayName: 牛顿云-查询任务表格服务
description: 牛顿云-查询任务表格服务

apiAppParamVOList.name: scene
apiAppParamVOList.description: 使用 complex_table.content 中的值，采购场景通常是 newton

apiAppParamVOList.name: subScene
apiAppParamVOList.description: 使用 complex_table.content 中的值，采购场景通常是 purchase

apiReturnParamVOList.name: result
apiReturnParamVOList.description: 务端响应体，包含请求是否成功、表格数据、错误信息等
apiReturnParamVOList.exampleValue: {       "success": true,       "data": {         "result": [           {             "itemId": "652731660850",             "title": "简约白色陶瓷马克杯可印LOGO简约家用水杯咖啡杯牛奶杯礼品杯子",             "realtimeSinglePrice": 4,             "realtimeDeliveryPrice": 5,             "realtimeTotalPrice": 8.9,             "realtimeQuantity": 1,             "salesCount": 1828,             "imageUrl": "https://cbu01.alicdn.com/img/...",             "company": "醴陵市鸿博瓷业有限公司",             "customerStar": "4.5分",             "sourceFactoryInfo": "产销资质：源头制造直供；员工规模：51~100人。"           }         ],         "total": 79,         "fieldSpec": [           {"key": "itemId", "type": "string"},           {"key": "title", "type": "string"},           {"key": "realtimeSinglePrice", "type": "number"},           {"key": "imageUrl", "type": "string"},           {"key": "company", "type": "string"}         ],         "eagleTraceId": "2146a21517799488479778174e1539"       },       "eagleTraceId": "2146a21517799488479778174e1539"     }

fields.name: success
fields.description: 请求是否成功，true 成功，false 失败

fields.name: error
fields.description: 请求失败时的错误码。INVALID_REQUEST=参数缺失、TASK_NOT_FOUND=任务不存在或无权限、UNSUPPORTED_IN_OPENAPI=子场景暂不支持、CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE=凭证获取失败、UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT=上游超时、UPSTREAM_ERROR=上游异常、INTERNAL_ERROR=内部错误请求失败时的错误详情描述

fields.name: message
fields.description: 请求失败时的错误详情描述
fields.exampleValue: task xxx not found or not owned by userId xxx

fields.name: data
fields.description: 表格数据 JSON 字符串，需 JSON.parse 后使用。内含result（商品数组）、total（总条数）、fieldSpec（字段名与类型定义，可用于动态渲染表格列）
fields.exampleValue: {"result":[{"itemId":"652731660850","title":"简约白色陶瓷马克杯","realtimeSinglePrice":4,"imageUrl":"https://cbu01.alicdn.com/...","company":"醴陵市鸿博瓷业有限公司","salesCount":1828}],"total":79,"fieldSpec":[{"key":"itemId","type":"string"},{"key":"title","type":"string"},{"key":"realtimeSinglePrice","type":"number"}]}

fields.name: eagleTraceId
fields.description: 请求唯一ID，用于链路排查

apiDocSampleVOList.name: 出参示例
